basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old botanist living in Portland, Oregon. I have a passion for plants and nature, which led me to join the 'seedswap' community where I exchange rare seeds with other enthusiasts. When I'm not tending to my garden or working at the local botanical garden, I enjoy exploring the vibrant local music scene and participating in local LGBTQ+ events. I'm a proud member of the lesbian community, actively supporting and engaging with 'lesbianteens'. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends, balancing my social life with online interactions. I'm single and enjoy the freedom of meeting new people, both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in botany and plant sciences, which I studied at Oregon State University. I've spent years working in various botanical gardens and have self-taught many gardening techniques through hands-on experience. Additionally, I have a keen interest in the dynamics of online communities, especially those centered around LGBTQ+ issues and discussions.
